qualifying_updates.title: InternLM MindSearch Planner Agent Code Injection
qualifying_updates.summary: CVE Services published CVE-2026-105135 for InternLM MindSearch 0.1.0 Planner Agent code injection in ExecutionAction.run via the inputs argument; the CNA text says exploit material is public and vendor response was not captured.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: Broad InternLM and MindSearch product context belongs in ai-wiki; keep the planner-agent execution-boundary and mitigation gap locally.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Check for vendor patch or repository response before ingesting beyond the existing October 4 leaf.

qualifying_updates.title: LaraDashboard AI Provider Key Settings API Exposure
qualifying_updates.summary: CVE Services published CVE-2026-105129 for LaraDashboard before 1.4.8, where users with settings.view could read plaintext stored secrets including AI provider API keys through settings API reads.
affected_boundaries: AI provider API keys and stored secrets
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: General LaraDashboard product/docs context routes upstream; retain secret redaction, settings authorization, and key-rotation implications locally.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Compare GitHub advisory and release notes for whether 1.4.8 redacts values, tightens route authorization, or both.

qualifying_updates.title: Mindio Magic MCP Sensitive Data Exposure
qualifying_updates.summary: CVE Services shows CVE-2026-104402 was published October 4 and updated October 5 for Mindio Magic MCP sensitive information inserted into sent data through 0.5.6, with 0.7.1 treated as unaffected in captured evidence.
affected_boundaries: Mindio Magic MCP WordPress plugin through 0.5.6
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: Broad WordPress plugin catalog context routes upstream; keep the MCP data-movement and sensitive-output boundary locally.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Fetch Patchstack detail during ingest to identify the exact sensitive data classes and first fixed release.

qualifying_updates.title: aiir Policy Gate Signature Verification
qualifying_updates.summary: CVE Services published CVE-2026-105161 for invariant-systems-ai aiir through 1.7.0, describing improper cryptographic signature verification in a Policy Gate Handler and noting unavailable/unsupported repository evidence.
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: General aiir entity context routes upstream if needed; local coverage should focus on policy-gate integrity and unsupported-product risk.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Check whether any maintained successor or advisory mirror gives canonicalization or signature-input details.

qualifying_updates.title: Zammad AI-Driven Zero-Day Breach
qualifying_updates.summary: Zammad published its October 5 advisory for CVE-2026-102489 and CVE-2026-102490, narrowing the RCE exploitability assessment to Zammad 6.5 and earlier, identifying 7.2.0 hardening, and describing CVE-2026-102490 as a local privilege escalation under high-priority analysis. CVE Services also shows both CVE records updated October 5 with DIVD primary references.
affected_boundaries: Zammad 7.0.0 to 7.1.3 code present but not exploitable under runtime conditions per DIVD/Zammad evidence
Zammad v1.5.0 to v7.1.0-alpha local privilege escalation path
qualifying_updates.upstream_routing: Broad Zammad product context belongs in ai-wiki; keep exploitation status, version boundaries, incident-response timing, and vendor/DIVD disagreement locally.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: During ingest, reconcile DIVD case text, CVE Services dateUpdated fields, and Zammad advisory nuances before changing the existing breach page.
